Her husband went to work from approximately 1:00 p.m. to 5:05 p.m.  When their son returned home from school at about 3:40 p.m., Francis was not home.  She has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2021000934.CaseDesc: On January 25, 2002, Vincent Lamouris was seen for the last time near the American Falls in Niagara Falls, New York. During the time of his disappearance, Vincent was despondent.

Case reference: 2005001599.CaseDesc: Shawn Jones and Leslie Jones were last seen together between October 26- 28, 1993, at the Tim Hortons in Owen Sound, Ontario.  Shawn was seen on Berford Street in front of the Pacific Hotel and Leslie was seen on 9th East Street in front of the Tim Hortons.

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Conrad was last known by family to be hitch hiking to a meeting in Dixonville, Alberta in July 2016. He was last seen in Manning, Alberta, in early September 2016.

Case reference: 2024067111.CaseDesc: Patrick Jimenez was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta on May 5, 2023. There has been no contact with friends or family since that time, which is out of character. Investigations to locate Patrick have been unsuccessful to date.

Case reference: 2024015900.CaseDesc: Mary Clarke left her residence in Guelph, Ontario, on April 8, 1990.  Her vehicle was later found abandoned in a parking lot in Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Coat: Wool, Blue, Tan, Knee length tweed trench coat.

Case reference: 2014001952.CaseDesc: On September 19, 1980, James Neckoway and a friend departed Bird, Manitoba by canoe for the purpose of hunting and fishing. Their plan was to travel down the Limestone River, followed by the Nelson River. The canoe in which the men were travelling and the body of his friend were recovered on September 23. James has not been located and is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2014005794.CaseDesc: On May 13, 2012 at 11 p.m., Pierre Desjardins left his residence in Notre-Dame-de-Lourdes, Quebec on foot and has not been seen since. Pierre was known to live a transient lifestyle and had made suicidal comments in the past.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Castle with a dragon on the bicep

Case reference: 2019009625.CaseDesc: On August 12, 2018, Nikhil Arun was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2006019799.CaseDesc: Anthony Evans was last seen on Jarvis Lake on June 12, 1984.  He fell from the boat he was in and his body has not been recovered.

Case reference: 2020015197.CaseDesc: On May 15, 2020, Tony Noskey was seen for the last time as he was riding a four-wheel all-terrain vehicle with his friends near the community of Cadotte Lake in Alberta. During the course of this outing, Tony had disappeared into the bush, and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014004835.CaseDesc: Ashleigh Pettman was last seen on June 3 2005 in the downtown area of Kelowna, British Columbia. She had moved to Kelowna from Grand Prairie, Alberta in March 2005 to live with her grandmother. In May 2005, Ashleigh gathered her belongings and moved out of her grandmother's residence to an unknown location.

Case reference: 2017045193.CaseDesc: Walter Allan departed from his residence in Wiarton, Ontario on July 18, 2017, to attend a coin collecting conference in Montreal, Quebec.  Walter did not attend the conference and was last seen on July 21, 2017, on security footage near Iberville, Quebec. Walter's vehicle was later located on August 24 2017 in a field near Saint-Barthelemy, Quebec.

Case reference: 2019070875.CaseDesc: On April 17, 2019, the remains of a woman were found in a crawl space of a triplex in Montreal, Québec.

Case reference: 2012020647.CaseDesc:
Ricky Riopel was reported missing in August 2010 by family members who had not seen or heard from him since December 2008. It was later established that he had been in Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan at a health care facility in October 2009.  
 
The last confirmed sighting of Ricky was in Saskatoon, at a downtown shopping mall, in September 2010. His parents are both failing in health which has prompted this additional request for public assistance.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Missing top front tooth

Case reference: 2022019878.CaseDesc: Ningyu Ma was last seen May 4, 2022 on Maryland St, Winnipeg, Manitoba. Ningyu was feeling despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2024061875.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2024, the Beaumont RCMP received a report that Shawn Edward Robson-Harder had not been seen in Beaumont since September 19, 2024. He had a history of frequenting major cities and First Nations throughout Alberta.  However, had never gone this long without checking in with friends. Shawn's friends and family are concerned for his well-being.

Case reference: 2014004448.CaseDesc: Carmelo Tomasino was last seen on January 19, 2004 in Montreal, Quebec. Carmelo's absence and not calling home is out of character.

Tattoo: Chest, Hearts with the text "Amanda and Brenda"

Case reference: 2006019099.CaseDesc: Janet Derbyshire was last seen on December 4, 1976, in St. Joseph Island near Sault Ste. Marie, ON.  She was seen jumping off the St. Joseph's Island Bridge into the water. She was seen floating downstream for approximately .25 miles (400 m) before she submerged under water. Janet is presumed drowned but her body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2014004476.CaseDesc: Gayebrella King was reported missing by her family on May 8, 1980. She was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta in late August 1978.

Case reference: 2012020067.CaseDesc: Bonnie Polwarth went missing from Brandon, Manitoba, on March 15, 1995. She had been undergoing counselling at the Brandon Mental Health Centre at the time of her disappearance. She is thought to have walked out of the facility on her own the day she went missing. She was supposed to be at work at 2:00 p.m. that day, but she did not show up and has been missing ever since.  Bonnie may have a forearm tattoo.

Jacket: Cream, Ivory, With green and brown

Case reference: 2014006229.CaseDesc: In 1981, Cyril Thistle was seen for the last time when he was out on day parole and visiting his sister.  There is reason to believe that Cyril lived a transient lifestyle as he was known in Toronto, Ontario and on the west coast of Canada.

Kennedy Airport in New York City, USA, where they then travelled on to Cairo, Egypt. It is believed that Houda and the children are actually in the United Arab Emirates.

Case reference: 2008018199.CaseDesc: Carl Braum and Thomas Lumsden were last seen on the morning of May 19, 1974. They were travelling in a 14-foot fibreglass canoe in a northerly direction in the area of Depot Harbour, Wasauksing First Nation, Parry Sound District, Ontario. They were believed to be travelling to Killbear Provincial Park. There were no life jackets in the canoe.

Case reference: 2014005455.CaseDesc: Mildred Nelson (née Flett) was last seen on June 20, 2010 in the downtown area of Winnipeg, Manitoba.  It is highly unusual for Mildred to be out of contact with her family and friends.

Case reference: 2014005302.CaseDesc: On November 11, 2005, in Toronto, Canada, Zaina Trujillo-Talib was abducted by her father, Chaudhry Talib and her paternal grandmother, Shama Talib.  Chaudhry and Shama immediately took six-year-old Zaina to their family home located in Lahore, Pakistan.  Since this time, Zaina's mother has not been allowed to have any contact with her daughter.

Case reference: 2013000021.CaseDesc: Bones of a right foot with its sock and shoe were found along the bank of the Ottawa river in Gatineau, Quebec.

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2021014303.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2013, at approximately 3:56 p.m., Peter Lipinoga was last seen in the area of Terrapin Point in Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of his disappearance, Peter was despondent.

Case reference: 2012020069.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1982, a resident of Gimli reported that Debbie Richardson first came to Gimli, Manitoba in 1972 to visit her brother. According to this report, she stayed with him for approximately three months and then went missing. Debbie's brother last saw her in September 1972 when he dropped her off on the highway to hitchhike to Winnipeg.  She has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014004406.CaseDesc: On January 2, 1973, Caroline Burns was last seen in the early morning leaving her residence in Molanosa, Saskatchewan. Molanosa is a small isolated community approximately 70 kilometers south of La Ronge, SK. Extensive searches of the area at the time failed to reveal any trace of Caroline.

Case reference: 2006004599.CaseDesc: Igor Tikhomirov jumped or fell off an oil tanker into Lake Ontario en route from Holland to Sarnia on May 12, 1996.  His body has never been recovered.

Shelley also has ties to the Timmins and Schumacher areas, as she lived there for most of her life.

Case reference: 2016008144.CaseDesc: Ben Trommels was last seen at his residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario, after being dropped off at 6:00 p.m. on Thursday, February 11, 2016. Case reference: 2022014288.CaseDesc: Lauren Craven was last seen by his family in Wildwood, Alberta on April 7th, 2022. Lauren was confirmed to be staying at the Grand Union Hotel in Coleman, Alberta from April 11th, 2022 till  check-out on June 16th, 2022. Lauren's vehicle was located abandoned near Sparwood, British Columbia on August 26, 2022 with a Lethbridge Prairie Post newspaper dated June 17th, 2022. Lauren was showing signs of early-onset dementia.

Case reference: 2014002145.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1975, William Garson, his father, his brother and a friend set out for a hunt in Moose Lake, Manitoba. On September 14, other hunters found gas cans and a thermos with the Garson name on it. These hunters reported their findings to the police.  A search was initiated and police found a boat sitting upright on the bottom of the lake. The depth of the lake around the boat was only 8 to 10 feet. Police believe the men encountered extremely rough water while crossing Moose Lake. The motors were found to be in forward gear. There was no flotation gear in the boat and it was heavily loaded with camping and hunting equipment. All bodies recovered except William, presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2014004752.CaseDesc: On June 4, 2005 a man attended the Victoria Police Department and reported not seeing Belinda Cameron for over one month.  He told police Belinda had mentioned wanting to visit relatives in Vancouver and Manitoba but did not provide names to police.  This man reported sharing an intimate relationship with Belinda outside of his own marriage.  He said she was not a habitual runaway.  This man denied harming Belinda and through a Polygraph examination was determined to be honest.  The Victoria Police investigated Belinda's disappearance and determined that Belinda suffered from a mental illness, had a drug addiction and may have been a sex trade worker.  The last confirmed sighting of Belinda was at Shoppers Drug Mart at 870 Esquimalt Rd.  She failed to attend thereafter to pick up her daily medication.

Hair: Black, Long, Separated in the middle

Case reference: 2006015899.CaseDesc: Pamela Holopainen was last seen in the city of Timmins, Ontario in the early morning hours of December 14, 2003, following a house party.

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 201lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2014001413.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1959, Captain Charles David Tillsley, Warrant Officer Tyrus Cobb, Sergeant Major James Mackey, and a fourth companion left Fort Churchill on a weekend fishing trip on the Churchill River in Manitoba. They were last seen loading their gear into a boat at the Churchill Dock at around 1 p.m. They were due back on September 20, but failed to return. Fort Churchill's military authorities commenced a search with the aid of helicopters and aircraft. On September 21, the two boats used by the men were located; both were undamaged and swamped. Numerous items belonging to the four men were found. Despite extensive land and water searches, the bodies were not found.

Case reference: 2014004814.CaseDesc: Stephanie Stewart was employed as a Fire Spotter at the Athabasca Lookout near Hinton, Alberta when she disappeared on August 26, 2006. She was 70 years old at the time of her disappearance. Stephanie led an active lifestyle and was in good health. Her disappearance is being treated as suspicious. The police investigation is ongoing.

Case reference: 2017068602.CaseDesc: On August 13, 2017, Martin Bertram McLearn was seen for the last time in South Rawdon, Nova Scotia. Martin has moderate dementia and was reported missing from his home.

Boots: Rubber, Size 7; old, worn and cracked

Case reference: 2014001538.CaseDesc: During the month of March, 1998, Theresa Johnny was seen for the last time in Whitehorse, Yukon. The last known contact with Theresa was on July 18, 1998, with the Anchorage Police Department in Alaska, United States. Over the years, there have been a number of unconfirmed tips received about Theresa’s location and well being.

Case reference: 2006016399.CaseDesc: Noriharu Amano was last seen on July 24, 2005 at the airport on Airport Road in Sault Ste. Marie. He left in a Cessna C-172 aircraft which had white wings with red tips, a red fuselage with white stripe and white underside. Top of engine cowling was red. The Cessna was last heard from as it was circling over Goulais Bay.

Case reference: 2024001138.CaseDesc: Michael Walker left his friend's home in Norland, Ontario, following a weekend party on November 5, 2023. He was thought to be returning to his father's home, which is located 15 minutes east of the small hamlet of Kinmount, Ontario. On November 6, 2023, Michael's father discovered Michael's vehicle parked in his driveway, open and without keys. Michael has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003009.CaseDesc: On the evening of September 30, 1979, Adolphe Thorassie and three hunting partners were returning home after a successful hunt on Tadoule Lake in Manitoba. Two men were in each boat. On the return journey, the men had to go ashore to get out of the wind. They set off again despite the strong winds on the lake, which made the water extremely dangerous with high waves. Adolphe was in the lead boat with his hunting partner and, unbeknownst to him, the second boat had to return to shore for engine repairs. Adolphe and his hunting partner never returned. The body of Adolphe's hunting partner was recovered and the cause of death was determined to be drowning. It is believed that Adolphe also drowned.

Case reference: 2005002599.CaseDesc: On October 21, 1989, an unidentified man was discovered in the area of County Road 14 in Napanee, Ontario.  Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts that this man was of south Asian ancestry.

Shirt: White, Brand: Pierre Cardin; grey, blue, and red thin stripes

Case reference: 2014004607.CaseDesc: George Robichaud was last seen by his roommate on March 15, 2005, at their home in Moncton, New Brunswick. George was suffering from mental health issues at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2018059144.CaseDesc: On October 9, 2018, Johnathan Braithwaite was seen for the last time as he was leaving the CIBC bank located on 45 King Street, in St. Catharines, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Johnathan was despondent.

Scar: Torso (Front), Scar from two gunshot wounds

Case reference: 2012020055.CaseDesc:
The body of an Asian male was discovered by cleaning staff at the Northbrook Inn in Grand Rapids, Manitoba.  The individual had checked in at 15:30h after arriving on the bus from Winnipeg.  At 18:00h cleaning staff entered the room to find the occupant deceased in a chair.
It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Case reference: 2008023299.CaseDesc: In the early morning hours of June 30, 2001, Istefan Toma returned home after work. He showered, changed his clothes and was observed leaving the family home at approximately 1 a.m. in his own vehicle. It was later discovered he had taken his identification and citizenship card, but did not take any clothing or other belongings with him. His vehicle was recovered from a parking lot in the vicinity of his work place at Woodbridge Mall (Hwy 7/Martingrove, Woodbridge, Ontario) on the 11th of February 2002, having been parked there for approximately 6-9 months. Istefan has not been in contact with any family members nor his employers since he left his home on the morning of June 30, 2001. He speaks broken English, is known to smoke DuMaurier cigarettes and has been known to attend casinos on occasion. His family and the police are concerned for his safety and well-being.

Mark: Nose, Mole on the right side of the nose

Case reference: 2006020699.CaseDesc: Frank Turtle was last seen on May 12, 1994 at South Camp on Peishk Lake, near Red Lake, Ontario. His boat was located but Frank was never found.  He is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2017040789.CaseDesc: In 2016, Samantha Fiddler left Canada to go to the state of Florida in the United States of America. Samantha was last known to be in the area of Bartow, Florida. Her family has not heard from her since November 2016.

Case reference: 2014004672.CaseDesc: On the 13th of June, 1995, Marcel Legris and a friend were last seen fishing on Cold Lake, SK. A large storm suddenly came up and it is believed that it swamped the boat they were using. The friend’s body was located, however, Marcel was never found.

Case reference: 2014004736.CaseDesc: Mary-Anne Loranger, her husband and their baby were camping on Beckwith Island in Georgian Bay for an unknown amount of time, prior to July 31, 1970. A storm occurred later that day and did not subside until August 4, 1970. It is believed the canoe they were in capsized at some point while they were on their way to Cedar Point.

Case reference: 2021055828.CaseDesc: Penny Yaroshuk was last seen leaving her residence in Edmonton, Alberta, on the morning of December 1st, 2021. Penny's vehicle was located abandoned in Hermitage Park, Edmonton, at 12:50 p.m. that same day. Family and friends have not heard from her since.

Case reference: 2010000599.CaseDesc: Bradley Allan Taylor was on his way home to Enfield, Nova Scotia from London, Ontario. He spent the night in Brockville, Ontario at the Travelodge Motel.  On January 10, 2009, he left the motel in the morning and later that day police found his car abandoned near a railway crossing in Roussillon, Quebec. Many of his personal belongings were found in the car. Police searched the area but Bradley was not located.

Hair: Brown, Long, Straight, Beard, Moustache, Sideburns

Case reference: 2014002498.CaseDesc: On June 12, 1995, Calahan Vandermint was reported missing by his girlfriend when she received a concerning letter from him. Calahan was staying at the Eastglen Motor Inn in Edmonton, Alberta. He was last seen riding his bike away from the motel on June 6, 1995.

Case reference: 2014002565.CaseDesc: On July 5, 1975, Carl Gallen was employed as a steelworker on the Long Spruce Dam project. He and his partner were working on a cement wall near the river. Carl was drilling into the wall when he fell into the water. His partner stated that he went directly under the water and did not see him surface. Carl wasn't wearing a harness or lifejacket. It's presumed he drowned.

Case reference: 2014005633.CaseDesc: On July 7, 2011, Dillon McMaster had been swimming in the Bow River in Alberta with a group of friends. Dillon was caught in a current, pulled under and was not seen again. Multiple efforts to locate Dillon were negative and he is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2015013522.CaseDesc: Richard St. Peter was in the process of moving residences. He was last heard from around Saturday March 14, 2015. It is not known where he may have gone, but he had vacated his last apartment and did not officially move into his new home.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Short, Receding hairline, salt and pepper goatee
